items.title: JJ Johnson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Symphony Sid had put together a group with you and Miles, Jimmy Heath, Milt Jackson and John Lewis to tour under the title of Jazz, Inc.

ctx.x: Was it during this period also that you began your long friendship with Jimmy Heath? I understand you all were doing a little bit of playing, you and he and Miles were playing together. Symphony Sid had put together a group with you and Miles, Jimmy Heath, Milt Jackson and John Lewis to tour under the title of Jazz, Inc. . . .
